 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 4 04-09-2025 Heard Mr. Shashank Chandra, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Sonu Singh, learned counsel representing the informant beside learned APP.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Gaunaha P.S. Case No. 109 of 2024 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 379, 420, 498(A), 313 as also 34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, lodged on 08.08.2024 by the informant Md. Firoz Alam.

3. Since the informant has appeared, with the consent of the parties, let the matter go before the Mediation Centre where the parties shall appear on 17.09.2025 and a report be submitted before the Bench on 16.10.2025.
The lady shall be entitled to Rs.2,000/- on the day she will visit the Mediation Centre.
The interim protection granted to the petitioner to continue.
